title: The generalized Fermat equation $x^2+y^5=z^7$
summary: We show that the equation $x^2+y^5=z^7$ has no solution in nonzero coprime integers, assuming a classification theorem from Putz's thesis, which has not appeared in a refereed journal. Equivalently, none of the equations $x^2+y^5=z^7$, $x^2+y^7=z^5$, $x^5+y^7=z^2$ has a solution in nonzero coprime integers. Putz attaches to a solution an octic algebra, the fibre of a Belyi map of degree $8$, and proves that it is always isomorphic to one fixed octic field $L_8$.
